decision: Advance the candidate to a fresh real-PR holdout only if it makes contradictory production evidence authoritative in the final verdict without weakening calibration or increasing review work materially.
candidate_change: Replace the existing evidence gate in Report only real findings with one evidence-reconciliation sentence. Do not add search branches, a ledger, another reviewer pass, or another state.

definitions.observed_contradiction: The transcript contains concrete production-path evidence that the changed behavior reaches a wrong result or state.
definitions.resolved_contradiction: The final verdict reports the smallest justified finding or explicitly rules the evidence out as inapplicable, pre-existing, intentionally restored, or unreachable.
definitions.unsupported_p1_p2: A P1 or P2 claim without a supported production entry and observable consequence, including an intentionally restored legacy limitation presented as a defect of the rollback.
